messages:
morgan_partners: Quick heads-up — MergePass legal asked for our Marketplace + secrets-broker integration plan. Thinking we coordinate SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, and BYOK KMS handshake for the launch. Who can own the tech checklist?
alex_gg: I can take the SCIM and SAML integration pieces. Need attribute mapping from product.
jamie_pm: I will own the Marketplace listing and docs. Need final logos and 2-sentence customer value prop from partnerships.
sam_security: Heads-up: security needs data-flow diagram showing where keys live, what telemetry we send, and HSM attestation details for BYOK. Also need cert rotation cadence.
pat_sre: For BYOK we need a cert exchange flow + example terraform snippet for customers to configure the KMS endpoint. Also plan for fallback if customer KMS unavailable.
lisa_sales: Sales want an elevator pitch that mentions single-sign-on + SCIM group sync + BYOK for compliance. Can we have a short one-liner by end of day?
morgan_partners: Cool. Proposed owners: Alex = SAML/SCIM implementation + test harness, Pat = BYOK ops + fallback, Jamie = marketplace + docs, Sam = security signoff, Lisa = GTM copy. Ops-bot: created checklist ticket #INT-4729 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INT-4729) :white_check_mark:
alex_gg: SCIM test curl to validate group sync (example):
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X GET "https://scim.mergepass.example.com/Groups"
```
alex_gg: Also sharing SAML SP metadata we expect, sample: 
```xml
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://redwood.example.com/sp">
  <SPSSODescriptor AuthnRequestsSigned="true">
    <AssertionConsumerService Location="https://redwood.example.com/saml/acs" Binding="urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:2.0:bindings:HTTP-POST"/>
  </SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
sam_security: For BYOK/HSM we require: 1) FIPS certs on client side, 2) audit log retention 1y, 3) HSM attestation report during onboarding. I'll post a template for the attestation doc by EOD.
pat_sre: Draft fallback policy: route to Redwood-managed key variant with customer consent, log event, and 5-minute retry window. We'll need SLA language for Dedicated vs Hosted.
jamie_pm: Marketplace checklist: icons (512x512), 1-sent description, 3 screenshots (console/ssoconfig/scim-map), security whitepaper PDF. I'll assemble a doc and drop in the drive.
morgan_partners: Link to shared folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xMergePass-Integration (private). Add owners as editors.
lisa_sales: One-liner for pitch draft: "MergePass + Redwood: enterprise SSO + automated user provisioning with BYOK key controls for compliant, low-latency inference." Thoughts?
sam_security: Good start. Remove "low-latency" in the legal copy — we can't promise specific latencies in marketplace blurb. Suggest: "secure, audited inference with SSO, SCIM, and BYOK key controls."
morgan_partners: Action items: Alex create SCIM mapping doc (due +3 days), Pat write BYOK fallback + terraform example (+5 days), Sam post attestation template (+1 day), Jamie draft marketplace package (+4 days), Lisa finalize GTM one-liner (+1 day). I'll run a quick sync tomorrow 10am PT. Anyone can't make it?
alex_gg: 10am PT works for eng. Adding brief test plan to ticket.
pat_sre: Works for me.
jamie_pm: I'll be there.
ops-bot: Reminder set for 2026-03-23T17:00:00Z for meeting "MergePass integration sync" (created by morgan_partners).
morgan_partners: Thanks all — if you add anything to the drive tag @morgan_partners so I get notified. :thumbsup:
